title: Alaska Air Group refreshes Atmos™ Rewards Visa® Business Card with Bank of America, offering higher earn rates and new travel benefits
summary: New benefits include four Alaska Lounge passes per year, a Global Entry / TSA PreCheck® statement credit every four years, free points sharing, and up to two 50%-off flight discounts annually after qualifying purchases
body_markdown:
#### Earn more as your business grows


Cardholders that spend $100,000 or more on card purchases annually earn 10,000 status points and a global discount code for 50% off the base fare on eligible Saver Fare or Main Cabin tickets. They earn both again when they spend $200,000 or more on purchases annually. That adds up to 20,000 status points and two discounts each card anniversary year. Status points count toward Elite status and are not redeemable for travel.


#### A faster path to status


The primary cardholder earns one status point for every $3 spent on eligible purchases, with no annual cap.


#### Relax before you fly


The primary cardholder receives four Alaska Lounge passes each calendar year, one per quarter. The card also includes up to $120 in statement credits for Global Entry® or TSA PreCheck® application fees every four years.


#### One fee for the whole team


A flat $195 annual fee covers the company, with no charge for additional employee cards. Previously, the fee was $70 per company plus $25 per employee card.


#### Travel with confidence


####


The primary cardholder gets fees waived on same-day confirmed flight changes and a $50 Instant Travel Delay Credit voucher, good for a meal or drink at the airport, when a flight is canceled or delayed for two hours or more on the day of travel.


#### Benefits that carry over


The refreshed card keeps a free first checked bag and preferred boarding on Alaska and Hawaiian flights for cardholders and up to six guests on the same reservation when the trip is paid with the card, a 20% rebate on eligible inflight purchases, a 10% rewards bonus for cardholders that hold an eligible Bank of America small business account, and no foreign transaction fees.


Beginning Nov. 18, customers who apply for a new Atmos Rewards Business card will apply for the refreshed card. Applications submitted before Nov. 18 will continue under the prior card offering, including applications that are still pending after the launch date. Current cardholders will keep their existing benefits and will not be moved automatically.


Already have an Atmos™ Rewards Visa® Business card opened before Nov. 18, 2026? Call 1-800-892-3219 to explore new benefit options.


Card is subject to credit approval. For information about rates, fees, other costs and benefits associated with the use of this credit card, please see the disclosures accompanying the credit card application. This credit card program is issued and administered by Bank of America, N.A.
